key_findings: KLF15 binds the Jmjd1c super-enhancer to activate Jmjd1c, whose expression depends on BRD4 and is reduced in spinal cord of SNI neuropathic pain rats.
Jmjd1c suppresses neuropathic pain and cytokines by H3K9 demethylation at the Socs3 promoter, inhibiting JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation.
